Q2  A Business man has two independent investment portfolios A and B, available to him but
he lacks the capital to undertake both of them simultaneously. He can either choose A
first  and  then  stop,  or  if  A  is  successful,  then  take  B  vice  versa.  The  probabilities  of
success of A is 0.6, while for B is 0.4. Both investment schemes require an initial capital
outlay of Rs 10000 and both return nothing is the venture proves unsuccessful. Successful
completion of A will return Rs 20000 (over cost) and successful completion of B will return
Rs 24000 (over cost). Draw a decision tree in order to determine the best strategy.
[5]
